why: T42's kill clause fired: bond_ce and bond_ce_unweighted are BOTH large at epoch 0 (13.51 vs 16.60 on wfa108j), so the transient is not the class-weight denominator.  The kill clause says to check the bond head's output-layer initialisation instead.
conclusion: The +2.0 NO_BOND bias was never a prior: the output weight was left at nn.Linear's default init, whose projection of the hidden state reaches |32| and swamps the bias.  Zeroing the weight at init drops the CE from the off-row to the on-row value on the identical cohort.
honest_limits: Initialisation only. It shows the head starts where the prior says it should; it does not show the run converges better, which needs a training run the standing directive forbids.
One seed, 8 clouds. The ratio is an init property, so seed spread matters only through the Linear init it removes.
